title: UK Man Kept Dead Mother In Freezer For 3 Years, Claimed Nearly Rs 1 Crore In Benefits
summary_full: A 60-year-old man in Wales has been jailed after keeping his mother's body in a chest freezer for nearly three years while continuing to claim her pension.
